argv:
(set -o pipefail) 2>/dev/null && set -o pipefail; ln -sf /tmp/codex-secrets/auth.json "$CODEX_HOME/auth.json"

if [ ! -d /logs/agent/sessions ]; then
  echo "Cannot resume Codex: no previous session logs found" >&2
  exit 1
fi
rm -rf "$CODEX_HOME/sessions"
cp -R /logs/agent/sessions "$CODEX_HOME/sessions"
